verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of markdown skills and bootstrap hooks loaded into existing agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It ships no UI and no service API of its own, so UI-versus-API parity is a category error for this kind of product. Its slash commands and skills run inside the host harness, and none of the evidence shows a first-party UI or API whose parity could be judged.
